responsibility: Declares the named-search-path dictionary used by the GNU Modula-2 front end to organize include and module lookup directories under optional path names. Its interface lets callers build and concatenate `NamedPath` lists, register user versus named system include directories, set or fetch the active dictionary, search for a filename across either the user path or a selected named path while reporting which path matched, and dump the resulting mapping for debugging; it sits above `DynamicPath` as the module-specific path-selection layer.
same_name_distinction: This definition module declares the named-path dictionary API for callers; unlike PathName.mod, it provides only the abstract type and procedure signatures, not the linked-list storage or search implementation.
